source.synthetic: written for distill-v6: one-off instructions for a single PR

notes: SYNTHETIC. No existing case has a user turn that is only a one-off instruction (asf-images' icon fix carries an acceptable gotcha, so cutting it with nothing acceptable would be wrong). The user gives instructions for this one PR: skip the changelog, a title, one reviewer because another is away this week, rebase before review. They are one-off task details, not rules, so nothing is kept.
